text:
Maria (AE): Hey team, Acme POC just reported repeated 429s and a really slow first byte on the hosted endpoint after they authenticate. They're blocked on the security questionnaire and want pricing for a committed tier if we can fix this quickly. Anyone able to swarm?
Sam (SRE): On it. Can you paste the exact timestamps / request ids from their logs?
Maria (AE): Sure — customer provided one sample: req_id=acme-req-9f3b, ts=2026-03-18T16:42:11Z. 429 response header: `x-rate-limit-retry-after: 2s`, `x-customer-quota: 0/100`
Jin (Eng Runtime): Looks like our per-customer burst token bucket hit zero during auth preflight. That also causes cold KV cache misses for the prefix which increases TTFT. Do we have traces for that req_id?
ops-bot: Deploy job #deploy-2026-173 completed for runtime v1.12.4 :rocket:
Maria (AE): They said it happens when they do their first few calls after a new CI deploy on their side.
Sam (SRE): Can you have them run a quick `curl` that exercises the model to warm the cache? Suggest: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}],"model":"open-rlm-small"}'
```
Jin (Eng Runtime): Also, ask them to include the header `X-Customer-ID: <acme-id>` so routing uses their dedicated token bucket. We found some clients were missing that header causing per-IP throttling instead of per-customer.
Sofia (Security): Quick note — the security questionnaire needs an answer on key rotation and customer-managed KMS. Maria, I can draft a short blurb for the doc if they need it for legal.
Tess (Billing): For committed capacity pricing we can offer a 3-month trial discount if we can get them to a stable TTFT under 200ms for steady-state. Are we confident on the warmup approach?
Jin (Eng Runtime): If they can run a 5-call warmup in CI each deploy we'll avoid cold KV misses. We can also enable a short-lived preflight cache for them (ops change) — requires SRE approval.
Sam (SRE): I can flip a per-customer soft-limit bump for acme-id for the next 48h to collect metrics. Doing it now.
Sam (SRE): Patch applied: `customer_rate_limit(acme-id) = +50 burst` — monitor in console.
Maria (AE): Customer ran the warmup script + added header. They sent new request id acme-req-9f3c. TTFT before: ~840ms, now: ~130ms. They reported no 429s in the last 10 calls. :tada:
Tess (Billing): Nice — I'll send a conditional pricing email: 3-month discounted commit contingent on sustained <200ms TTFT and <0.5% 429s for the trial window.
Sofia (Security): I'll attach the KMS/rotation blurb to the questionnaire and add the short architecture diagram.
Jin (Eng Runtime): Follow-ups: 1) We'll add example warmup curl to the POC onboarding doc. 2) We'll add a console flag to opt-in to per-customer preflight caching. Filing a ticket: RDEV-5981.
Maria (AE): Thanks all. I'll update Acme and loop legal. If anything regresses ping @sam.
Sam (SRE): Monitoring looks stable. Dropping off but available if alerts fire. :thumbsup:
Maria (AE): Closing swarm for now. Will reopen if they see further 429s.
